responsibilities: GitHub Action inputs, environment wiring, review lifecycle, and failure handling
contracts: Existing inputs retain compatible defaults and documented behavior
The requested review strategy reaches the matching runtime and publishing path
invariants: Secrets are not written to logs, command arguments, artifacts, or model-visible context
A failed or incomplete analysis cannot be presented as a successful review

responsibilities: Policy validation, deterministic coverage, durable specialist sessions, budgets, recovery, and adjudication
contracts: Version-2 policy selects bounded work without granting tools, hosts, models, or budgets
Artifacts account for selected, completed, omitted, degraded, and unresolved obligations
invariants: Session lifetime limits survive recovery and cannot reset through a new conversation
High-risk unresolved coverage cannot silently become approval-ready
Untrusted current-branch policy changes cannot widen web or publishing authority

responsibilities: OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible requests, streaming, structured responses, and read-only evidence tools
contracts: Both supported API formats preserve their required message and tool-call ordering
Streaming and non-streaming responses normalize to equivalent complete model results
Model-provided values cannot escape repository, command-catalog, repository-API, or web-source boundaries
invariants: API keys never appear in process arguments or retained evidence
Tool execution remains read-only and policy constrained
Retries, watchdog recovery, and context compaction remain bounded

responsibilities: Verdict enforcement, concise human handoff, inline findings, managed metadata, and re-review cleanup
contracts: The handoff summarizes scope and review focus while detailed evidence remains in resolvable notes
Published findings are sanitized, deduplicated, and anchored only to valid diff lines
invariants: This repository policy cannot publish approvals or native verdict reviews
Open carried-forward blocking findings continue to prevent a positive recommendation
Upstream references and reserved metadata cannot create notification spam or corrupt managed state

responsibilities: Regression coverage, migration guidance, public configuration documentation, and repository review policy
contracts: Documented defaults and examples match action.yml and runtime validation
Tests cover behavior rather than only implementation shape
invariants: Migration guidance does not recommend deprecated or ineffective inputs
Security and compatibility claims have executable or directly inspectable evidence

recipes.title: Action interface and orchestration compatibility
recipes.objective: Trace changed inputs, defaults, environment propagation, strategy routing, timeouts, and failure states through action.yml and the shell orchestration.
invariants: Existing callers keep compatible behavior unless a breaking change is explicit
Every public input reaches the intended runtime setting and validation
Failure and degraded states cannot fall through to misleading publication
expected_evidence: Changed action input and its consuming environment or runtime path
Focused input, shell, routing, or failure-path tests

recipes.title: Durable specialist session safety
recipes.objective: Examine session continuity, policy authorization, coverage accounting, deadlines, lifetime budgets, recovery, and final adjudication as one state machine.
invariants: A logical session cannot regain turns, tools, recovery, or time by reconstructing context
Every required obligation has an auditable terminal status
Unauthorized head policy changes can only preserve or narrow authority and safety
expected_evidence: Relevant state transitions and persisted counters
Boundary tests for exhaustion, recovery, authorization, and unresolved coverage

recipes.title: Model API and stream compatibility
recipes.objective: Trace request construction and response assembly for both supported provider formats, including native tools, structured verdict turns, streaming deltas, retries, and cancellation.
invariants: Provider-specific tool-call and tool-result ordering remains valid
Stream reassembly preserves complete arguments and finish reasons
A retry cannot duplicate unsafe work or exceed the enclosing session budget
expected_evidence: Wire-format comparison for each affected API format
Streaming and non-streaming tests for the affected response shape

recipes.title: Tool, network, and secret boundaries
recipes.objective: Independently challenge path resolution, command catalogues, GitHub repository scoping, web allowlisting, redaction, and API-key handling for realistic exfiltration or mutation paths.
invariants: Model-controlled text is never executed as shell
Filesystem and repository API access cannot escape the configured scope
Only policy-authorized HTTPS documentation URLs can be fetched
Secrets are redacted before evidence reaches models, logs, or artifacts
expected_evidence: Concrete guard and normalization path for every changed boundary
Adversarial test covering the plausible bypass

recipes.title: Publishing and human-handoff hygiene
recipes.objective: Verify verdict enforcement, managed review lifecycle, inline anchoring, sanitization, carry-forward behavior, and the separation between concise handoff and detailed notes.
invariants: Policy and workflow keep publication non-approving
Detailed claims and evidence are not duplicated into the handoff summary
Invalid anchors or cleanup failures cannot discard the underlying review
expected_evidence: Resulting GitHub review event and fallback behavior
Tests for carried findings, anchors, sanitization, and managed cleanup

recipes.title: Tests and documentation contract verification
recipes.objective: Check that behavioral changes have focused regression coverage and that documented inputs, defaults, migration advice, and examples match executable behavior.
invariants: Tests exercise observable outcomes and meaningful boundaries
Documented defaults and lifecycle labels match action.yml
Migration examples do not restore deprecated pass-based behavior
expected_evidence: Focused test that fails without the behavior under review
Direct comparison between documentation and source-of-truth defaults
